title: Bears announce trade for DT Jeffery Simmons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears announce trade for DT Jeffery Simmons
sources.description: It was a very big day for the Chicago Bears; they added one of the best defensive tackles in the league, and they're reportedly closing in on a deal to stay in Illinois.
